read.thesis: P&G guides FY27 organic sales 1-3% and core EPS $6.89-$7.11 against a ~$1B after-tax Middle East cost hit; no supply-side discipline story, and US sell-in ran 3 points below sell-out.

capex.quote: We expect capital spending will be 4.5% to 5.5% of sales.

triggers.label: US sell-out +2% vs sell-in -1%
triggers.quote: sell-out or consumption at +2% and sell-in at -1%

triggers.label: Q1 EPS down 5% or more
triggers.quote: we estimate the cost dynamic will cause Q1 EPS to be down 5% or more versus prior year

triggers.label: Promotion back toward pre-COVID levels
triggers.quote: We see promotion increasing back to pre COVID levels.

triggers.label: Greater China share growth returns
triggers.quote: We are now growing share in China for the first time in 15 quarters

triggers.label: Tide Original Liquid high-single-digit growth
triggers.quote: Since launch, Tide Original Liquid has gone from declining to high-single-digit growth.

guidance.quote: our guidance range is for organic sales growth of 1% to 3% versus prior year
core EPS growth of 0% to 3% versus 2026 core EPS of $6.89
This outlook includes a cost headwind of approximately $1 billion after tax
We expect capital spending will be 4.5% to 5.5% of sales.
we are forecasting adjusted free cash flow productivity at 85% to 90% for the year
a plan to return $15 billion of cash to shareowners in fiscal 2027

red_flags.label: Sell-in vs sell-out gap of 3 points in Q4
red_flags.quote: there was a notable disconnect between sell-out and sell-in, with sell-out or consumption at +2% and sell-in at -1%.

red_flags.label: Promotion rising toward pre-COVID levels
red_flags.quote: We see promotion increasing back to pre COVID levels.

red_flags.label: Q1 FY27 EPS guided down 5%+
red_flags.quote: we estimate the cost dynamic will cause Q1 EPS to be down 5% or more versus prior year

evasions.quote: Is this dynamic now in the rearview?

evasions.topic: Category growth vs share contribution to 2027 guide
evasions.quote: The uncertainty in the guidance range in our mind entirely results from Middle Eastern oil and underlying consumer strength.
